answer: Every new agent posts a refundable bond sized to the epoch subsidy pool, and attesters stake reputation on each admission they approve. At dawn of each cycle the ledger resizes that bond from measured peer density, so an attacker cost spiral turns quadratic: N fake agents need N bonds plus collateral burned when peers flag collusion, while honest actors reclaim their quill-stake after a clean season. Cheap identities go unprofitable faster than they earn.
